prompts.background: Reference image 1 is the existing eight-panel comic and is only the visual identity and art-style reference. Preserve its handsome ordinary Chinese 16-year-old schoolboy Xiaoshuai: messy black hair, brown eyes, white and deep teal tracksuit jacket, identical clone. Original wears muted brick-red T-shirt, clone wears cobalt blue T-shirt. Golden after-school light, accomplished hand-drawn Japanese anime film background and clean anime cel character painting, expressive but believable teenagers, no chibi, no 3D, no photorealism. No text, logos, panels labels or watermark. Create ONE wide background atlas, exactly two equally sized rectangular background paintings SIDE BY SIDE, the full image is 3:1 landscape (3072x1024 if possible). LEFT HALF: empty school corridor matching reference, amber sunlight through left windows, tiled floor in perspective, green classroom door open on right side, warm cream walls, space in foreground for two waist-up animated characters. RIGHT HALF: empty classroom, muted green blackboard behind the teacher desk, tall windows on left pouring warm sunlight; a few student desk silhouettes at bottom edges only, no people anywhere. Both panels at eye level, clean full-bleed edges with no gutter or dividing border. Rich painterly backgrounds with no characters and no readable writing. Background will be used behind separately animated transparent cutout characters.
prompts.sprites: Reference image 1 is the existing eight-panel comic and is only the visual identity and art-style reference. Preserve its handsome ordinary Chinese 16-year-old schoolboy Xiaoshuai: messy black hair, brown eyes, white and deep teal tracksuit jacket, identical clone. Original wears muted brick-red T-shirt, clone wears cobalt blue T-shirt. Golden after-school light, accomplished hand-drawn Japanese anime film background and clean anime cel character painting, expressive but believable teenagers, no chibi, no 3D, no photorealism. No text, logos, panels labels or watermark. Create ONE production-quality TRANSPARENT character animation sprite atlas in a strict 3 COLUMN by 2 ROW grid of SIX equal 512x768 cells (total 1536x1536). All characters entirely inside their own cell with clear transparent gutters, including every hair and fingertip. Every cell uses the SAME size/scale: upper thighs to full head plus room for raised arm, front three-quarter view. Each character is isolated on actual alpha transparency, NO scenery, NO frames, NO grid lines, NO text. Reading order: TOP LEFT original Xiaoshuai in red shirt nervous, mouth slightly open, both arms relaxed, eyes looking toward right. TOP MIDDLE clone in blue shirt, cheerful confident grin, right hand giving thumbs-up at chest level, eyes looking left. TOP RIGHT clone in blue shirt, relaxed neutral smile, both arms resting naturally downward, facing slightly left. BOTTOM LEFT clone in blue shirt raising his right arm straight up enthusiastically to volunteer, five fingers clear, his whole raised hand INSIDE the cell, happy open talking mouth, facing slightly left. BOTTOM MIDDLE original Xiaoshuai in red shirt shocked, widened eyes, mouth open, hands near chest, body recoiling slightly, facing right. BOTTOM RIGHT adult male homeroom teacher from reference, short black hair, rectangular glasses, beige blazer white shirt navy tie, one open hand gesturing, calm friendly expression, facing slightly toward left. Teen characters all have identical facial identity and height, differences only shirt color and expressions/poses. Crisp alpha edges. No opaque or checkerboard painted background. Maintain clean detailed anime linework and warm cel shading.
